name: Communication Systems
description:
Review of Fourier Series and Transforms, Energy spectral density, Bandwidth. Hilbert Transforms and Bandpass Signal and System Representation. 
Random Processes, Stationarity, Power Spectral Density, Gaussian Process, Additive white Gaussian Noise. 
Analog communication techniques - Amplitude modulation, Angle modulation, Superheterodyne receiver, Phase-locked loop. 
Analog to digital conversion, PCM, DPCM, Delta modulation, Line coding schemes
Digital modulation - Geometric representation of signals, Signal constellations, PAM, QAM, Design for bandlimited channels – the Nyquist criterion, Orthogonal modulations.
Optimal demodulation, ML and MAP decision rules, Error analysis in presence of Gaussian noise.
Introduction to Information Theory: concepts of Entropy and Source-Coding
